segs.en: Michael needs to walk to school every day from downtown. There're $$$n$$$ crossings and $$$m$$$ paths connecting these crossings. Michael starts by crossing $$$1$$$ he needs to reach crossing $$$T$$$. Now, because of the fabulous New England weather, each path $$$i$$$ is either covered in snow with depth $$$x_i$$$ or cleared of snow by the hard-working oppressed lower class. Walking in snow is tiring, so walking along each snowy path increases Michael's dreariness $$$d$$$ by $$$1$$$. Further, walking on snow costs Michael energy. The energy of crossing the path $$$i$$$ is $$$d \times x_i$$$. Find the minimum energy Michael needs to get to school.

zh.ai: Michael 每天都需要从市中心步行去学校。这里有 $$$n$$$ 个路口，以及连接这些路口的 $$$m$$$ 条道路。Michael 从 $$$1$$$ 出发，需要到达 $$$T$$$。现在，由于新英格兰糟糕的天气，每条道路 $$$i$$$ 要么被深度为 $$$x_i$$$ 的积雪覆盖，要么已被辛勤劳作却受压迫的下层阶级清理干净。在雪地中行走非常劳累，因此沿着每条积雪道路行走都会使 Michael 的疲惫度 $$$d$$$ 增加 $$$1$$$。此外，在雪上行走还会消耗 Michael 的能量。通过道路 $$$i$$$ 的能量消耗为 $$$d \times x_i$$$。求 Michael 到达学校所需的最小能量。

segs.en: The first line contains 3 integers $$$n,m,T$$$ $$$(1\le n\le 1000,1\le m\le \min(1000,\frac13 n^2), 1\le T\le n)$$$. The following $$$m$$$ lines each contains 3 integers $$$a_i,b_i,x_i$$$ $$$(1\le a_i,b_i\le n,0\le x_i\le 100)$$$.

zh.ai: 第一行包含 3 个整数 $$$n,m,T$$$ $$$(1\le n\le 1000,1\le m\le \min(1000,\frac13 n^2), 1\le T\le n)$$$。接下来的 $$$m$$$ 行每行包含 3 个整数 $$$a_i,b_i,x_i$$$ $$$(1\le a_i,b_i\le n,0\le x_i\le 100)$$$。

segs.en: Print the minimum energy Michael needs to get to school. Output -1 if he cannot.

zh.ai: 输出 Michael 到达学校所需的最小能量。如果他无法到达，则输出 -1。
